decisions.reason: As a recent, adjacent enterprise communications offer, it still has option value and can be kept on the market at modest cost even though competition makes its upside uncertain.
It fits the firm's strategic move toward data-centre and cloud connectivity and early customer adoption suggests enough promise to continue scaling rather than abandon it.
This high-bandwidth optical connectivity service builds directly on the firm's owned network assets and remains strategically important while market demand continues to unfold.
The portal extends the existing voice business with a low-cost digital interface, so management would keep the option open while observing uptake and efficiency gains.
Carrier pre-selection is a legacy telephony offering with limited fit to the firm's software-defined growth path, so weak future value would justify reallocating resources elsewhere.

Direct voice network connection is close to the core enterprise connectivity business, and despite being voice-related it still merits another year because uncertainty about customer stickiness has not fully resolved.
